ev_0004.summary: Circle centered at O (point_08, approx (302.6,293.3), radius approx 235 px) through A, B, C, D. Straight strokes: AB (short, left), AC, AD (passes through H), BC (horizontal), BD, CD, and HO (H to O, solid). H is the midpoint of AD and OH is perpendicular to AD (checked by dot product, about -113 on lengths about 250 and 250). All strokes appear solid; no dashed strokes detected. point_02 (126,286) lies on AC and point_06 (177,188) lies on HO, so both are spurious crossing points and not vertices.
